failure_modes.name: Insufficient_Retrieved_Evidence
failure_modes.evidence: (i) Summary_1 explicitly identifies the gap: 'The passages confirm Bobby Hurley is "currently the head coach of the Arizona State men's team," but there is NO information in the passages about Arizona State's ranking or whether it is the "highest ranked men's basketball team."' and summary_2 states 'the characterization of Arizona State's men's basketball team as the "highest ranked men's basketball team" is unsupported by the provided passages and cannot be verified.' (ii) However, hop 2 query 'Dan Hurley, Robert Matthew Hurley, Bobby Hurley, Rhode Island Rams basketball, Arizona State Sun Devils basketball' does include 'Arizona State Sun Devils basketball' as a target, attempting to retrieve information about Arizona State's program. Despite this retrieval attempt across all three hops, no passages about Arizona State's ranking or status ever arrived - a corpus/retriever coverage gap.
